subject: NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: Gen7 V3 VIDEO_PASSTHROUGH policy is not connected to actual overlay lifecycle
body: Independent V3 verification PASS for ZIP/checksums/package validator/patcher self-test/core harness. Material integration defect confirmed: Gen7AndroidCoordinator returns VIDEO_PASSTHROUGH, but the V3 PanelEngine cutover consumes only gen7.visual and never suppresses/detaches the Gen7PublicGlassSurface. In addition, the 1.2s video-evidence TTL only expires when Gen7VideoEvidenceTracker is polled by a later accessibility event; currentEvidence() is never wired into frame/service policy, so coordinator currentVideo can remain ACTIVE_EXACT_CURRENT after TTL. Privacy still outranks video, but the public-media exact-current contract and promised passthrough behavior are not implemented. Disposition: NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE / REVISION_REQUIRED before V3 promotion.
required_primary_action: wire TTL freshness into render/service loop
make VIDEO_PASSTHROUGH alter actual public-glass surface lifecycle
add positive->idle-expiry and surface-mode regression tests
